# When something goes wrong

| It says, or does | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `The site cannot be reached:` | Every address of the site took no connection, or its name did not resolve: the network, or the site is down. The run stops; try later. |
| one address takes no connection (SITE-06) | The site's own defect: runs pass or fail by which address the computer is handed. Its bug blocks the tests it breaks. Run against a name that avoids it: `BASE_URL=https://staging.example.com npm test`. |
| many pages slower by the same time | One cause, the way to the site; not the pages. |
| a page at its time limit | It passed, and a slower day fails it: the run says which. |
| the suite's rules fail | A generated file was edited outside its YOURS blocks, or a test breaks how tests are written: the rule says where and what to change. |
| it needs something not installed | Node 20 or newer, and `npm ci` then `npx cypress install` once in this folder. |

`crew`, then "Ask Claude anything about this suite", for anything else: Claude Code opens here and answers in
your words.
